title: Veg Masala Omelette
steps: Beat eggs with salt in a small bowl.
Sauté chopped onion, tomato, chili, and capsicum in a pan until softened.
Pour in the beaten eggs, cook until set, fold, and serve hot.

title: Paneer Tikka Wrap
steps: Marinate paneer cubes in a mixture of yogurt and spices for 15 minutes.
Sauté the marinated paneer with sliced onion and capsicum until charred.
Place the mixture inside a warm roti, wrap tightly, and serve.

title: Chickpea Salad
steps: Finely chop the cucumber, tomato, and onion.
In a large bowl, mix the veggies with boiled chickpeas, lemon juice, and salt.
Toss well to combine and serve chilled.

title: Paneer Butter Masala
steps: Sauté onions, ginger, and garlic in oil until transparent.
Add tomatoes, salt, and cashews; cook until tomatoes are mushy.
Blend the mixture with water into a smooth puree and strain it.
Melt butter in a pan, add the puree, spices, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in paneer, kasuri methi, and cream; cook for 2 minutes and serve.

title: Aloo Paratha
steps: Knead a soft dough using flour, water, and a pinch of salt.
Mash boiled potatoes and mix with spices, chilies, and salt to make the stuffing.
Stuff a small ball of dough with the potato mixture and seal the edges.
Roll into a flat disc and cook on a hot griddle with ghee until golden brown.

title: Spicy Vegan Potato Curry
steps: Boil potato cubes in salted water until tender, then drain.
Sauté onion and garlic in oil; add curry powder, cumin, and ginger.
Stir in potatoes, chickpeas, and coconut milk; simmer for 10 minutes.

title: Vada Pav (Mumbai Style)
steps: Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves; add potato mash, turmeric, and chili paste.
Shape the potato mixture into balls.
Make a thick batter of besan and rice flour; dip the balls and deep fry until golden.
Serve inside a pav with garlic chutney and green chutney.

title: World's Best Lasagna
steps: Cook meat with onions and garlic; add tomatoes and simmer for 1.5 hours.
Boil lasagna noodles and mix ricotta with egg and parsley.
Layer meat sauce, noodles, ricotta mixture, and mozzarella in a baking dish.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 50 minutes until bubbly and browned.

title: Creamy au Gratin Potatoes
steps: Layer potatoes and onions in a greased casserole dish.
Make a roux with butter and flour; whisk in milk until thickened.
Stir in cheese until melted and pour the sauce over the potatoes.
Cover with foil and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 1.5 hours.

title: Spinach and Feta Turkey Burgers
steps: Squeeze all excess moisture from the thawed spinach.
Mix turkey, spinach, feta, eggs, and garlic in a bowl; form into 8 patties.
Grill over medium-high heat for 15-20 minutes until the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C).

title: Bengali Fish Curry
steps: Marinate fish with turmeric and salt for 10 minutes.
Fry the fish in hot mustard oil until lightly golden and set aside.
In the same oil, sauté mustard paste and chilies, add water, return the fish to the pan, and simmer until cooked.

title: Gujarati Dhokla
steps: Create a smooth batter with besan, yogurt, turmeric, and ginger; let it rest.
Stir in baking soda and immediately steam the batter for 15 minutes.
Temper mustard seeds in oil and pour over the steamed dhokla; slice and serve.

title: Thai Green Curry
steps: Fry the curry paste in a little coconut milk until aromatic.
Add chicken and peppers, followed by the remaining coconut milk.
Simmer until chicken is tender; garnish with basil and serve with jasmine rice.

title: Mexican Enchiladas
steps: Mix shredded chicken with a splash of salsa and chopped onions.
Dip tortillas in salsa, fill with chicken mixture, and roll tightly.
Place in a baking dish, top with remaining salsa and cheese, and bake at 180°C until melted.

title: Dosa
steps: Soak rice and dal for 6 hours, then grind into a fine, smooth batter.
Allow the batter to ferment in a warm place for 8-12 hours.
Spread a ladle of batter onto a hot tava in a circular motion, drizzle oil, and cook until crisp.

title: Italian Pizza
steps: Prepare a yeast-leavened dough and let it double in size.
Stretch the dough, spread a thin layer of tomato sauce, and add mozzarella chunks.
Bake at the highest oven temperature (220°C+) for 10-15 minutes; top with fresh basil.

title: Chettinad Chicken
steps: Dry roast coconut and spices, then grind into a thick masala paste.
Sauté shallots and curry leaves, add chicken and the ground paste.
Add a little water and simmer until the chicken is tender and the gravy thickens.

title: Litti Chokha (Bihari Special)
steps: Prepare a stiff dough with flour, water, and salt.
Mix sattu with mustard oil, lemon juice, ajwain, kalonji, and chopped chilies for the filling.
Stuff dough balls with sattu and roast over a slow flame until browned.
Roast eggplant and tomatoes; mash them with potatoes, mustard oil, and salt to make chokha.

title: Tehri (UP Style Veg Pulao)
steps: Sauté whole spices (cloves, bay leaves) in ghee inside the pressure cooker.
Add potatoes, cauliflower, and peas; sauté with turmeric and salt for 2 minutes.
Add soaked rice and 3 cups of water.
Pressure cook for 2 whistles and serve hot with curd or pickle.

title: Sattu Paratha
steps: Mix sattu with onion, chilies, coriander, mustard oil, and a spoonful of mango pickle masala.
Roll a dough ball, stuff it with the sattu mixture, and flatten it.
Cook on a hot tava with ghee until both sides are crisp and golden.

title: Banarasi Dum Aloo
steps: Prick baby potatoes and deep fry until golden brown.
Prepare a gravy with tomato puree, curd, cashew paste, and dry spices.
Add the potatoes to the gravy and simmer on low heat (Dum) for 15 minutes.

title: Dal Pitha (Bihari Dumplings)
steps: Grind soaked chana dal with garlic and chilies into a coarse paste.
Make a soft dough using rice flour and hot water.
Stuff small dough pockets with the dal paste and seal.
Steam the dumplings for 15-20 minutes until the rice flour casing is firm.

title: Chicken Galouti Kebab (Lucknowi Style)
steps: Marinate meat with raw papaya paste for 1 hour to tenderize.
Mix in ginger-garlic paste and the special spice blend (Galouti masala).
Shape into delicate patties and shallow fry in ghee until they are 'melt-in-mouth' soft.

title: Japanese Ramen
steps: Simmer broth with miso and soy sauce for 10 minutes.
Boil noodles separately and place them in a deep serving bowl.
Pour hot broth over noodles and top with halved egg, sliced onions, and nori.

title: Greek Salad (Horiatiki)
steps: Roughly chop tomatoes, cucumber, and onion into large chunks.
Place in a bowl with olives and top with a large block of feta cheese.
Drizzle generously with olive oil and sprinkle with dried oregano.

title: Malpua (UP/Bihar Dessert)
steps: Make a batter using flour, khoya, and milk; let it sit for 2 hours.
Deep fry small pancakes of the batter in ghee until the edges are crisp.
Soak the fried malpuas in warm cardamom-flavored sugar syrup for 5 minutes.

title: Classic Beef Steak
steps: Season the steak heavily with salt and pepper on both sides.
Sear in a smoking hot skillet for 3 minutes per side.
Add butter, garlic, and rosemary; baste the steak with the melted butter for 2 more minutes.

title: Bihari Fish Curry (Sarson Masala)
steps: Grind mustard seeds and garlic into a very fine, smooth paste.
Marinate fish with salt and turmeric; fry in mustard oil until crisp.
Temper oil with panch phoron, sauté the mustard paste and tomatoes until oil separates.
Add water to create a thin gravy, bring to boil, add fish, and simmer for 5 minutes.

title: Baingan ka Bharta (UP Style)
steps: Roast the eggplant over an open flame until the skin is charred and the inside is soft.
Peel the charred skin, mash the pulp, and ensure there are no lumps.
Sauté onions, ginger, and garlic in mustard oil; add tomatoes and spices.
Mix in the mashed eggplant and cook for 10 minutes on low heat for a smoky flavor.

title: Thekua (Bihari Traditional Cookie)
steps: Dissolve jaggery in a small amount of warm water to make a thick syrup.
Mix flour, ghee, fennel, and coconut; add jaggery syrup to form a tight, stiff dough.
Take small portions, press them onto a mold or flatten with palms to form patterns.
Deep fry on low heat until dark golden brown and crunchy.

title: Matar Paneer (Dhaba Style)
steps: Fry paneer cubes until golden and soak in warm water to keep them soft.
Make a paste of sautéed onions and tomatoes; cook in ghee with spices.
Add peas and water; simmer until the peas are tender.
Add paneer and cream, simmer for 2 minutes, and garnish with coriander.

title: Chana Dal with Lauki (UP Style)
steps: Pressure cook soaked dal and lauki with turmeric, salt, and water for 4-5 whistles.
Prepare a tadka (tempering) by heating ghee/oil with cumin and hing.
Add chopped onions and red chilies to the tadka; fry until brown.
Pour the tadka over the cooked dal and mix well.

title: Chicken Biryani (Hyderabadi)
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, and spices for 2 hours.
Parboil rice with whole spices until 70% cooked.
Layer marinated chicken and parboiled rice in a pot; add fried onions, mint, and saffron.
Seal the pot with dough (Dum) and cook on very low heat for 45 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
steps: Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Fry pancetta in a pan until crisp; whisk eggs and cheese in a separate bowl.
Toss pasta in the pan with pancetta (off the heat).
Quickly stir in the egg mixture, adding a splash of pasta water to create a creamy sauce.

title: Korean Bibimbap
steps: Sauté vegetables individually with a touch of sesame oil and salt.
Cook the meat/tofu with soy sauce and garlic; fry one egg sunny-side up.
Place rice in a bowl, arrange veggies and meat in sections on top.
Add a dollop of gochujang and the egg; mix everything thoroughly before eating.

title: Hummus (Middle Eastern)
steps: Combine chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, and garlic in a food processor.
Blend until smooth, adding a little water or olive oil to reach desired consistency.
Transfer to a bowl, create a well in the center, fill with olive oil, and sprinkle with paprika.

title: Nimona (UP Winter Special)
steps: Coarsely grind the green peas into a paste.
Sauté potatoes and mangodi in mustard oil until brown; set aside.
Fry the pea paste in the same oil until the raw smell disappears.
Add water, spices, and fried potatoes; simmer until the gravy is thick and flavorful.

title: Original Indian Street Omelette
steps: Whisk eggs with onions, chilies, coriander, turmeric, and salt.
Melt a large cube of butter on a hot tawa and pour the mixture.
Place two slices of bread on top of the wet egg, flip when set, and fold the edges over the bread.

title: Hyderabadi Mutton Haleem
steps: Soak wheat and lentils for 4 hours.
Cook meat with spices until falling off the bone; remove bones and mash meat.
Cook wheat/lentils until mushy, combine with meat, and mash continuously with ghee until a thick, elastic consistency is reached.

title: Puran Poli (Maharashtrian)
steps: Boil chana dal, drain water, and cook with jaggery until it forms a thick paste (Puran).
Sieve the paste to remove lumps and add cardamom/nutmeg.
Stuff a portion of puran into wheat dough, roll thin, and roast on a tava with plenty of ghee.

title: Kashmiri Wazwan Rogan Josh
steps: Sear lamb in mustard oil with whole spices.
Add yogurt whisked with ginger and fennel powder; cook on low heat.
Infuse with ratanjot oil for the signature deep red color and simmer until meat is tender.

title: Goan Fish Curry
steps: Grind coconut, red chilies, tamarind, and coriander seeds into a fine orange paste.
Bring the paste to a boil with water and kokum.
Add fish pieces and simmer for 5-7 minutes until cooked.

title: Mysore Masala Dosa
steps: Spread dosa batter thin on a hot tawa.
Apply a generous amount of butter and spread the spicy red chutney over the surface.
Place potato masala in the center, fold, and cook until the base is dark golden and crispy.

title: Lucknowi Veg Shami Kebab
steps: Pressure cook chickpeas and potato with spices until soft.
Grind to a very smooth paste without adding much water.
Mix in chopped mint and onions, shape into patties, and shallow fry in ghee.

title: Amritsari Kulcha
steps: Knead a multi-layered flaky dough using flour and butter.
Stuff with a spicy mashed potato mixture containing anardana (pomegranate seeds).
Bake until crisp and top with a large dollop of white butter.

title: Assamese Masor Tenga
steps: Fry turmeric-coated fish and set aside.
Sauté tomatoes with panch phoron until mushy.
Add water to make a thin broth, add fish and lemon juice for a refreshing sour taste.

title: Rajasthani Laal Maas
steps: Soak Mathania chilies and grind to a paste.
Slow cook mutton with garlic, chili paste, and oil in a handi.
Smoke the curry with a burning charcoal piece and ghee (Dhungar) to get a traditional smoky finish.

title: Pani Puri (Gol Gappa)
steps: Prepare 'teekha pani' by blending mint, chilies, and lemon with water.
Prepare 'meetha pani' with tamarind and jaggery.
Poke a hole in the puri, fill with potato-chickpea mix, dip in both waters, and serve instantly.

title: Kerala Puttu and Kadala Curry
steps: Steam layers of moistened rice flour and grated coconut in a cylindrical Puttu maker.
Cook black chickpeas in a spicy coconut-based gravy.
Serve the steamed Puttu with the Kadala curry and a small banana.

title: Banarasi Kachori Sabzi
steps: Make small puris stuffed with spicy urad dal (Kachori).
Prepare a thin, spicy potato curry (Sabzi) heavily flavored with hing and black pepper.
Deep fry kachoris until crisp and serve hot with the watery potato curry.
